A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Critic-V and contain 16 pages, including four pages of supplementary material covering Sections 6–14. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original Critic-V benchmark evaluations, ablations, and case studies in Section 3, plus token-consumption statistics and training curves in the supplement.

after.justification: v4 retains the original Critic-V evaluations in Tables 1–4 and the supplementary token-consumption and training results.

M1.justification: Section 2 and supplementary Algorithms 1–3 retain the same Reasoner-Critic interaction, VEST data construction, Jaccard/GPT scoring, and DPO training procedure. No method component or update rule changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use critique-VQA and the same eight evaluation benchmarks: RealWorldQA, MMStar, MMBench, SEEDBench, ScienceQA, MMT-Bench, MathVista, and MathVerse. No datasets, tasks, or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same VLM comparators. Table 2 retains POVID, CSR, SIMA, and SCL, while Tables 3–4 retain Self-Refine and the prompt-only comparison. Comparator membership is unchanged within each experiment.

E3.justification: Section 3.1 and supplementary Sections 9, 10, and 14 report identical evaluation procedures, training budgets, generation parameters, and benchmark sample counts. No new evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: The DPO/Self-Refine and prompt ablations, ScienceQA and SEEDBench case studies, token-consumption analysis, training curves, and dataset examples are retained without substantive revisions.

E5.justification: Table 6 retains the same reporting of mean and standard deviation for token counts. Neither version reports benchmark confidence intervals, significance tests, or repeated-run counts; uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: The numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout both PDFs and their appendices. For example, Table 1 reports Qwen2-VL-7B+Critic-V scores of 73.2 on MathVista and 82.8 on MMBench in both versions.

T1.justification: Equations 1–9 and their mathematical explanations are unchanged. Equation 1 moves across a page boundary, but no definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same framework, critique-dataset, and plug-and-play critic contributions, including the abstract's five-of-eight benchmark claim. The grammar correction does not alter claim meaning or scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning external feedback, DPO effectiveness, prompt controls, mathematical reasoning, and token overhead are unchanged. No substantive limitations, failure conditions, or applicability qualifications are added.

D1.justification: v4 adds first-page addresses labeled 'Paper and Dataset Link' and 'Code', pointing to Hugging Face and GitHub. This adds resource-access information; implementation details remain unchanged. The PDFs alone do not establish the linked resources' availability or completeness.

R1.justification: The same 69 references and related-work positioning are retained. Changes to citation back-reference page numbers reflect text reflow, with no cited works added or removed.

P1.justification: v4 updates author affiliations and the first-page header, adds resource pointers, and corrects 'effectively guiding' to 'effectively guide'. The section organization and substantive prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded first-page header shifts the abstract, introduction, and Figure 1 downward and changes subsequent text and equation page breaks. Figure and table content, captions, and structures are unchanged; the appendix pages render identically.

improvement.justification: v4 offers a limited usability improvement by adding explicit resource pointers absent from v1 and correcting a grammatical error. The scientific content and appendix evidence remain unchanged. The benefit is better resource documentation; actual resource availability cannot be verified from the supplied PDFs.
